exact: DNA polymerase III, DnaX complex, chi/psi subcomplex

definition: A dimer composed of the chi and psi subunits which is a subassembly of the DNA polymerase III clamp loader complex and serves as a bridge between the DnaX complex and the single-stranded DNA-binding protein (SSB).
label: DNA polymerase III, clamp loader chi/psi subcomplex
